sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Ariocarpus scaphirostrus is a slow-growing cactus endemic to Nuevo León, northeastern Mexico. Its flattened body is largely subterranean, with a visible rosette usually about 4–9 cm across; magenta flowers can approach 4 cm. The plate shows a more exposed plant than its naturally buried habit.

sections.title: Conservation and safety
sections.text: The IUCN lists the species as Endangered. This is a protected, slow-growing cactus, not a food plant; no edible use was verified.
